video.title: AI欧腐《揣着龙蛋跑路了/Pregnant with the Dragon Prince's Heir》
video.desc:
Asher, a short-lived snake demon, wears fake dragon horns and infiltrates the Dragon Clan Academy to survive past the age of twenty-two. He tricks Kyle, the Dragon Prince, into bonding with him for life and even conceives his dragon egg. However, he soon discovers that Kyle already has a fiancé chosen by the Dragon Council, and that Kyle has openly stated his hatred for snakes. Terrified, Asher hides his pregnancy and flees overnight, prompting the Dragon Clan to issue a wanted order. As Kyle investigates the truth, he gradually realizes he has long fallen in love with Asher. Defying the council’s opposition, he insists on searching for Asher and their child. In the end, Kyle finds Asher, fully accepts his identity as a snake demon, and stands with him to face the pressure from the Dragon Clan, protecting their child and their love together.
Asher是一只短命的蛇妖，为了活过二十二岁，他戴上假龙角混入龙族学院。他设计让龙族王子Kyle与自己缔结终生契约，甚至怀上了他的龙蛋。然而他很快发现，Kyle早已有了龙族长老会选定的未婚夫，而且Kyle曾公开表示自己厌恶蛇类。惊恐之下，Asher隐瞒了怀孕的事连夜出逃，龙族随即对他发出通缉令。在追查真相的过程中，Kyle渐渐意识到自己早已爱上了Asher。他不顾长老会的反对，执意要找回Asher和他们的孩子。最终，Kyle找到了Asher，完全接纳了他蛇妖的身份，与他并肩面对来自龙族的压力，共同守护他们的孩子和爱情。
